facts.fact: VanDusen has more than 7,500 plant species and varieties, a hedge maze and an award-winning visitor centre.
Most paved paths and major buildings are wheelchair accessible, but paths can be uneven; an accessibility map is available. Pets are not allowed, except working guide and service dogs.
